document_type: selectivity preregistration (frozen before any A5 case-level selectivity outcome)

steps: insert a boundary between a lower/digit character and an uppercase character (camelCase splitting; runs before casefolding)
replace every run of characters outside [a-z0-9] with one space (underscores, dots, slashes, hyphens, punctuation are separators)
split on whitespace; drop empty tokens
deduplicate (set semantics); no stopwords; no stemming
tokenization_contract.applied_identically_to: every query-side and candidate-side string; no filename-specific tokenization

primary_signal_formula.query_token_set: tokens(question) UNION tokens(plan.concepts) UNION tokens(plan.symbols), from the frozen BRIDGED-cell question and frozen plan fields

candidate_token_sets.title_tokens: tokens(candidate title from the frozen payload registry)

primary_signal_formula.primary_score: path_overlap + title_overlap (integer; duplicate tokens within a field do not count — set semantics)

minimum_relevance_criterion.semantics: a candidate with primary_score < 1 has no query-grounded relevance signal and is rejected (zero_score_rejected) even when selectivity slots remain; select none rather than fill to the cap

supporting_signal_formula.support_rank: minimum 1-based rank of the candidate across the frozen BRIDGED-cell non-graph channels (exact, dense, sparse, paper, workflow); null when absent
supporting_signal_formula.role: secondary ordering key only; never hard eligibility, never mandatory support, never a dominant score, never an extra vote; a bridge-only candidate with no channel support remains fully able to win selectivity on primary score alone
supporting_signal_formula.position_in_ordering: after primary score, before structural distance

plan_scope_filter.scope_set: set(plan.target_repositories) UNION set(plan.version_repositories) UNION set(plan.resolved_versions keys), from the frozen plan fields
plan_scope_filter.semantics: if the scope set is non-empty, a candidate whose source_id is outside it is rejected (scope_rejected); if the scope set is empty, no rejection
plan_scope_filter.not_a_bonus: in-scope candidates receive no score advantage; the filter is eligibility-only

structural_tie_break.structural_distance: min_structural_distance_transitions (minimum reachability budget consumed across the receipts that produced the candidate)
structural_tie_break.role: late tie-break only; governed closeness is never treated as query relevance; sorts after primary score and support rank; candidates with missing distance sort last deterministically

per_origin_diversity_semantics.provenance_origin_identity: the governed provenance-bearing structure that produced the candidate: evidence_provenance_origin_id from the frozen bridge receipts (e.g., a reached relation edge id); a candidate independently produced by several origins belongs to ALL of them
per_origin_diversity_semantics.grouping_prohibition: origins are never grouped by case ID, filename substring, or expected evidence group
per_origin_diversity_semantics.application: process candidates in the tie-break order; a candidate is selectable if at least one of its origins has fewer than 4 selected candidates attributed; attribute to the least-used origin (tie: lexicographically smallest origin_id); a candidate whose every origin is at capacity is skipped as origin_capped_out

global_cap_semantics.semantics: ceiling: selection stops at 8; if fewer candidates meet the minimum relevance criterion, fewer are selected; never fill with irrelevant candidates

failure_behavior.no eligible universe: selected count 0; the case is a valid fail-closed outcome

candidate_authority: GOVERNED_PROVENANCE_BACKED_ADDITIVE_RETRIEVAL_CANDIDATE with identity authority NONE; selectivity never introduces a candidate and selected_bridge_candidates is a subset of eligible_governed_bridge_candidates

graph_reconstruction_contract.method: existing additive-prefix merge semantics on ordered object-id lists: selected candidates (in selection order) prefixed onto the frozen unbridged graph ordering, deduplicated by stable object_id, truncated to the frozen graph channel limit 20
graph_reconstruction_contract.unbridged_graph_source: the frozen STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED cell graph ordering
graph_reconstruction_contract.no_change_to: fusion weights, graph channel limit, unbridged baseline, or any runtime behavior
graph_reconstruction_contract.diagnostic_only_fusion: if recomputed, fused positions are diagnostic only; no rerank admission, no reserved slots

invariants: SELECTIVITY_CAP and PER_ORIGIN_CAP respected in every case
deterministic: identical fixture input yields byte-identical output (verified by double execution per case)
no model calls, no extra embeddings, no runtime changes

a5_decision_rule_preregistration.comparison: BASELINE_BRIDGED (the frozen A2 bridge candidate state before A5 selectivity: the old provenance-order cap output) versus SELECTIVITY_ONLY (same eligible governed candidate universe + this frozen policy + PER_ORIGIN_CAP=4 + SELECTIVITY_CAP=8); no admission treatment; the reference is NOT A2's STRUCTURED_UNBRIDGED arm
a5_decision_rule_preregistration.material_reduction: for a high-fan-out case: selected_bridge_candidate_count < eligible_governed_bridge_candidate_count AND ordinary_graph_candidates_displaced_after_count < ordinary_graph_candidates_displaced_before_count
a5_decision_rule_preregistration.no_new_control_expansion: for every case: ordinary_graph_candidates_displaced_after_count <= ordinary_graph_candidates_displaced_before_count and selected_bridge_candidate_count <= baseline_old_cap_admitted_count
a5_decision_rule_preregistration.applicability_rule: required evidence never present in the eligible governed bridge universe (e.g., structurally unreachable evidence) is NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_SELECTIVITY and never counts as a selectivity failure
a5_decision_rule_preregistration.evaluator_retention_check: after all case outputs are frozen, evaluator-only metadata (frozen A2 combined-pool match provenance) identifies applicable required-evidence candidates in each eligible universe; retention = applicable set is a subset of the selected set

requires_all: fixture equivalence gates passed (frozen in Commit 1)
all selected candidates governed and scope-compatible
deterministic replay verified (byte-identical double execution per case)
material_reduction holds for every high-fan-out case
evaluator retention: all applicable required-evidence bridge candidates for the designated positive mechanistic cases (g036, g021) are retained
PASS / SELECTIVITY_MECHANISM_VALIDATED_F.meaning: development/mechanistic validation only; NOT end-to-end retrieval validation

a5_decision_rule_preregistration.PARTIAL / SELECTIVITY_FANOUT_REDUCED_WIT: fan-out/displacement reduced but one or more applicable relevant bridge candidates are lost
a5_decision_rule_preregistration.FAIL / SELECTIVITY_NOT_USEFUL: fan-out remains uncontrolled, or ordering is not deterministic, or governance/scope invariants fail, or applicable relevant-candidate retention is materially poor
a5_decision_rule_preregistration.INVALID: fixture not equivalent, or scoring changed after A5 outcome exposure, or multiple unregistered variants tried

anti_tuning_boundary.note: the scoring contract above was fixed from the A4 frozen signal families, generic synthetic examples, and repository field availability only; no A2 case was run through the policy before this preregistration was committed
